data.title: ‘World’s best pastry chef’ stays true to artisan roots
data.description: PARIS - The smell of warm bread hangs in the air at one of Benoit Castel’s patisseries in Paris, where the newly crowned world’s best pastry chef was hard at work testing new recipes.

data.title: Thai Cabinet backs income tax exemption for ACAI’s foreign staff
data.description: The measure would cover salaries and remuneration received from Thursday (June 6, 2024), while the Finance Ministry estimates an annual revenue loss of THB1.7 million.

data.title: Jaspal Group expands regional fashion and lifestyle portfolio with SATUR launch
data.description: Jaspal Group , or Jaspal Public Company Limited, is reinforcing its position as “a regional fashion and lifestyle house of brands” , drawing on its strengths in developing and growing its own brands while serving as a strategic partner for international brands looking to establish and expand their presence in Thailand and across the region.

data.title: Syria sentences Assad to death in absentia for atrocities
data.description: DAMASCUS - A Syrian court on Tuesday sentenced former ruler Bashar al-Assad to death after a trial in absentia, convicting him of atrocities committed during the country’s nearly 14-year civil war.

data.title: The Global Economic Forum Annual Meeting Bangkok Legacy Week 10th to 14th October 2026
data.description: Asia’s foremost economic platform extends an overarching invitation to sovereign governments, public policy architects, global CEOs, institutional investors, trade associations, civil society organizations, and academic institutions from more than 100 countries to shape regional economic strategy, advance research and innovation, and drive cross-border investment as the strategic prelude to Bangkok’s major international financial assemblies.

data.title: French homebuyers rethink choices after heatwaves
data.description: PARIS - After multiple severe heatwaves in a single summer, French residents are increasingly factoring high temperatures into their home searches, realtors say, bumping up features such as shutters, air conditioning and indirect sunlight on their priority lists.

data.title: Motorcyclist loses race with barrier at Makkasan crossing
data.description: A motorcyclist attempting to bypass a railway barrier near the Makkasan station in Bangkok on Monday ended up losing control and crashing onto the tracks.

data.title: Thai PM suspends firearm purchase licences after school shooting
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul ​on Tuesday suspended the issuance of permits ​to buy firearms and ‌said existing licences would be reviewed, days after a 14-year-old gunman killed nine people.

data.title: Ethiopian rebels condemn army drone strikes
data.description: ADDIS ABABA - Rebel authorities in the Tigray region of Ethiopia on Tuesday accused the federal government of carrying out deadly drone strikes in the northern region, denouncing “a serious escalation” amid fears of a new war.

data.title: Ukraine says Russia fired North Korean missiles
data.description: KYIV - Russian attacks across Ukraine killed at least nine people overnight and wounded dozens, Kyiv said on Tuesday, accusing Moscow of launching North Korean missiles in the raid.

data.title: Myanmar military intensified air attacks and abuses before election
data.description: Aerial attacks, frequency and intensity of abuses have increased before election, report says

data.title: Authorities raid drug den in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - A raid on a suspected drug den in Kathu district on this tourist island has uncovered a large amount of drugs and firearms, provincial authorities said on Tuesday.

data.title: Jasmine prices surge ahead of Mother’s Day
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - Jasmine flower prices for Mother’s Day garlands have surged more than 30% compared with a year ago, forcing vendors to raise garland prices while absorbing part of the higher costs to avoid driving away customers.

data.title: Japan's Bonbon Drop sticker craze spurring sellouts, fakes
data.description: Sticker trading that was popular among children decades ago is making a comeback in Japan, but this time with a new range leading the trend.

data.title: BMW driver arrested with illegal firearm in car
data.description: The driver of a BMW sedan was arrested after police found found a pistol and 28 rounds of ammunition concealed under his seat at a checkpoint in Phuket’s Muang district on Monday night.

data.title: Trump says would be 'terrible mistake' to oust embattled Infantino
data.description: WASHINGTON — United States President Donald Trump said on Monday it would be "a terrible mistake" to replace Gianni Infantino, the embattled Fédération Internationale de Football Association (Fifa) president who tried, and failed, to sell off part of the World Cup to private investors.

data.title: Sri Trang Rises to No. 105 on Fortune Southeast Asia 500, Tops Thai Rubber Sector
data.description: Sri Trang Agro-Industry Public Company Limited (STA) , The world’s largest fully integrated natural rubber enterprise and Thailand’s leading rubber glove manufacture, has once again been recognized as one of Southeast Asia’s largest companies in the 2026 Fortune Southeast Asia 500 , ranking No. 105, up five places from No. 110 last year. STA also secured the highest ranking among Thai rubber companies included in this year’s list, reinforcing its competitive strength and demonstrating the global competitiveness of Thailand’s natural rubber industry.

data.title: Fujitsu Urges Thai Manufacturers to Modernize Legacy ERP Ahead of End-of-Life Risks
data.description: When Legacy ERP Reaches End-of-Life:Building a Digital Foundation Before Costs Spiral Out of Control By Mr. Jun Hashimoto, Country Representative, Fujitsu (Thailand) Co., Ltd.

data.title: Schools closed as Indonesia battles wildfires
data.description: SURABAYA (INDONESIA) — Dozens of Indonesian schools were shuttered for a second day Tuesday against the spreading haze of wildfires plaguing the archipelago at the start of a long and intense dry season worsened by El Nino.

data.title: Hungary parliament to elect Orban-critic judge as president
data.description: BUDAPEST — Hungarian lawmakers on Tuesday are expected to elect former supreme court chief Andras Baka, who was fired under ex-premier Viktor Orban, as the country's next head of state.

data.title: Russian barrage on Ukraine kills 9, wounds dozens
data.description: KYIV — Russian attacks across Ukraine killed at least nine people overnight and wounded dozens, authorities said Tuesday, after Kyiv warned that Moscow had received more ballistic missiles from North Korea.

data.title: Accused murderer Chalong in court, denied bail
data.description: Police have charged politician Chalong Riewraeng with premeditated murder and other serious offences in the shooting death of the Nonthaburi provincial administration chief, and he was denied release on bail by the provincial court on Tuesday.

data.title: Connecting the physical and digital worlds
data.description: Happitat, a project by Axtra Happitat Co Ltd, a subsidiary of CP Axtra, has launched one of Southeast Asia's largest and highest-resolution indoor digital displays, spanning 385m² with an ultra-fine P1.8 pixel pitch, and opens its doors on Aug 21.

data.title: Jealous adult son stabs, shoots mother’s boyfriend
data.description: SONGKHLA - A 29-year-old man stabbed his mother’s new partner at least 10 times before shooting him dead with his own handgun on Sunday night.

data.title: 40% of flights grounded in Shanghai as long-lived Typhoon Dolphin moves north
data.description: Shanghai airports cancelled nearly 40% of all flights on Monday as heavy rain continued after Typhoon Dolphin made landfall in eastern China on Sunday evening and continued to move north.

data.title: 2,300-year-old wine found near Great Wall ruin
data.description: BEIJING — A well-preserved bronze Warring States-era wine vessel containing 2,300-year-old wine was discovered at the Shanjiabao cemetery. Here it is pictured in the lab.

data.title: What next for beleaguered Fifa president Infantino?
data.description: PARIS — Embattled Fédération Internationale de Football Association (Fifa) president Gianni Infantino's hope that a combative statement condemning "a concerted and ongoing effort" to undermine him would spark a period of reflection were dashed on Monday.

data.title: 'Dear You' (2026): A love letter to overseas Chinese in Thailand
data.description: It felt like a striking coincidence that I had just watched ' The Thai Interpreter ' last week, a movie about the struggles of Thai immigrants in the United States with its justice system. ' With Dear You ' (2026), the filmmakers tackle something smaller but just as universal: a long-distance love between a man in Thailand and a woman in China, divided by 3,000 kilometres of sea and land. Set around the 1950s, during the fifth wave of Chinese migration to Thailand, it takes us back to a time when a long-distance parting truly meant you might never see the one you love again.
